description: This source file implements the SiftUploader class, responsible for collecting analytics events from a store, composing JSON payloads, and posting them to a server endpoint. It manages a background thread to asynchronously handle data collection, upload retries, and response validation.

classes.name: SiftUploader
classes.description: A class responsible for asynchronously collecting analytics events, composing JSON payloads, and posting them to a backend server, with retry logic and response validation.

methods.name: setDeviceInfoRequiredFields
methods.description: Sets device-related identifiers such as account ID, device ID, and partner ID for inclusion in analytics events.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main thread loop that manages different uploader states, including waiting, collecting events, and posting analytics data.

methods.name: PerformWaitIfRetryNeeded
methods.description: Implements exponential backoff for retries when posting fails, waiting between attempts.

methods.name: RandomisationWindowTimeGenerator
methods.description: Generates a randomized delay within the maximum window to stagger uploads.

methods.name: CollectEventsFromAnalyticsStore
methods.description: Retrieves a specified number of events from the analytics store.

methods.name: ComposeJSONEventArrayToBeUploaded
methods.description: Converts a list of event strings into a JSON array after validating each event.

methods.name: updateEventDeviceInfoIfRequired
methods.description: Adds device and account information to events if not already present.

methods.name: validateResponse
methods.description: Validates the server response, checking for rejected events and logging relevant information.

methods.name: PostJson
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST with JSON data to the specified URL and returns the HTTP response code.
